examples.cn_plain: 锻炼对身体很重要，同样对心理健康也有好处。

examples.en: [Although] it was raining, we still went for a hike in the mountains.
examples.cn: [虽然]下雨，我们还是去山里徒步了。
examples.en_plain: Although it was raining, we still went for a hike in the mountains.
examples.cn_plain: 虽然下雨，我们还是去山里徒步了。

examples.en: She smiled [although] she was feeling very sad inside.
examples.cn: [尽管]内心非常悲伤，她还是微笑着。
examples.en_plain: She smiled although she was feeling very sad inside.
examples.cn_plain: 尽管内心非常悲伤，她还是微笑着。

examples.en: [Although] he is young, he has a lot of experience in teaching.
examples.cn: [尽管]他年轻，他在教学方面却经验丰富。
examples.en_plain: Although he is young, he has a lot of experience in teaching.
examples.cn_plain: 尽管他年轻，他在教学方面却经验丰富。

examples.en: The food was expensive, [although] the quality was excellent.
examples.cn: 食物价格不低，[不过]质量确实很好。
examples.en_plain: The food was expensive, although the quality was excellent.
examples.cn_plain: 食物价格不低，不过质量确实很好。

examples.en: [Although] they are twins, they have very different personalities.
examples.cn: [虽说]他们是双胞胎，性格却截然不同。
examples.en_plain: Although they are twins, they have very different personalities.
examples.cn_plain: 虽说他们是双胞胎，性格却截然不同。

examples.en: She [always] gets to school early to prepare for the day.
examples.cn: 她[总是]早早到校，为一天的学习做准备。
examples.en_plain: She always gets to school early to prepare for the day.
examples.cn_plain: 她总是早早到校，为一天的学习做准备。

examples.en: My grandfather [always] tells me to be honest and work hard.
examples.cn: 我爷爷[总是]告诉我要诚实、努力工作。
examples.en_plain: My grandfather always tells me to be honest and work hard.
examples.cn_plain: 我爷爷总是告诉我要诚实、努力工作。

examples.en: This small town has [always] been known for its beautiful lake.
examples.cn: 这座小镇[始终]以其美丽的湖泊而闻名。
examples.en_plain: This small town has always been known for its beautiful lake.
examples.cn_plain: 这座小镇始终以其美丽的湖泊而闻名。

examples.en: No matter what happens, I will [always] be there for you.
examples.cn: 不管发生什么，我[永远]都会在你身边。
examples.en_plain: No matter what happens, I will always be there for you.
examples.cn_plain: 不管发生什么，我永远都会在你身边。

examples.sense: adv. 随时都可以（退而求其次）
examples.en: If you're busy, you can [always] come back tomorrow.
examples.cn: 如果你忙的话，你[随时]可以明天再来。
examples.en_plain: If you're busy, you can always come back tomorrow.
examples.cn_plain: 如果你忙的话，你随时可以明天再来。

examples.en: She has always dreamed of visiting [America] and seeing the Statue of Liberty.
examples.cn: 她一直梦想着去[美国]参观自由女神像。
examples.en_plain: She has always dreamed of visiting America and seeing the Statue of Liberty.
examples.cn_plain: 她一直梦想着去美国参观自由女神像。

examples.en: Many international students go to [America] to study at university.
examples.cn: 许多国际学生去[美国]上大学。
examples.en_plain: Many international students go to America to study at university.
examples.cn_plain: 许多国际学生去美国上大学。

examples.en: North [America] is the third largest continent in the world.
examples.cn: 北[美洲]是世界第三大洲。
examples.en_plain: North America is the third largest continent in the world.
examples.cn_plain: 北美洲是世界第三大洲。

examples.en: South [America] is home to the Amazon rainforest.
examples.cn: 南[美洲]拥有亚马逊热带雨林。
examples.en_plain: South America is home to the Amazon rainforest.
examples.cn_plain: 南美洲拥有亚马逊热带雨林。

examples.sense: n. 美国（文化/生活方式）
examples.en: Baseball is often considered the national sport of [America].
examples.cn: 棒球常被认为是[美国]的国家运动。
examples.en_plain: Baseball is often considered the national sport of America.
examples.cn_plain: 棒球常被认为是美国的国家运动。

examples.en: [American] food is popular around the world, especially hamburgers.
examples.cn: [美国]食物在世界各地广受欢迎，尤其是汉堡包。
examples.en_plain: American food is popular around the world, especially hamburgers.
examples.cn_plain: 美国食物在世界各地广受欢迎，尤其是汉堡包。

examples.en: She is very interested in [American] history and culture.
examples.cn: 她对[美国]历史和文化非常感兴趣。
examples.en_plain: She is very interested in American history and culture.
examples.cn_plain: 她对美国历史和文化非常感兴趣。

examples.en: My pen pal is an [American] from California.
examples.cn: 我的笔友是一个来自加利福尼亚的[美国人]。
examples.en_plain: My pen pal is an American from California.
examples.cn_plain: 我的笔友是一个来自加利福尼亚的美国人。

examples.en: She met an [American] at the language exchange event last weekend.
examples.cn: 她上周末在语言交流活动中遇到了一位[美国人]。
examples.en_plain: She met an American at the language exchange event last weekend.
examples.cn_plain: 她上周末在语言交流活动中遇到了一位美国人。

examples.en: Native [American] culture has a long and rich history.
examples.cn: 美洲[原住民]文化有着悠久而丰富的历史。
examples.en_plain: Native American culture has a long and rich history.
examples.cn_plain: 美洲原住民文化有着悠久而丰富的历史。

examples.sense: prep. 在...之中（三者及以上）
examples.en: She sat [among] her friends and laughed all afternoon.
examples.cn: 她坐在朋友们[中间]，笑了整个下午。
examples.en_plain: She sat among her friends and laughed all afternoon.
examples.cn_plain: 她坐在朋友们中间，笑了整个下午。

examples.sense: prep. 在...之中（三者及以上）
examples.en: This song is [among] the most popular ones this year.
examples.cn: 这首歌是今年最受欢迎的歌曲[之一]。
examples.en_plain: This song is among the most popular ones this year.
examples.cn_plain: 这首歌是今年最受欢迎的歌曲之一。

examples.en: There is a wolf hiding [among] the sheep.
examples.cn: 羊群[中间]藏着一匹狼。
examples.en_plain: There is a wolf hiding among the sheep.
examples.cn_plain: 羊群中间藏着一匹狼。

examples.en: The teacher divided the prizes [among] the top three students.
examples.cn: 老师把奖品分给了前三名学生。
examples.en_plain: The teacher divided the prizes among the top three students.
examples.cn_plain: 老师把奖品分给了前三名学生。

examples.en: The students discussed the problem [among] themselves before asking the teacher.
examples.cn: 学生们先在[彼此之间]讨论了这个问题，再去问老师。
examples.en_plain: The students discussed the problem among themselves before asking the teacher.
examples.cn_plain: 学生们先在彼此之间讨论了这个问题，再去问老师。

examples.en: We learned about [ancient] Egypt in history class today.
examples.cn: 我们今天在历史课上学习了[古代]埃及。
examples.en_plain: We learned about ancient Egypt in history class today.
examples.cn_plain: 我们今天在历史课上学习了古代埃及。

examples.en: [Ancient] Chinese inventions changed the world, like paper and printing.
examples.cn: [古代]中国的发明改变了世界，如造纸术和印刷术。
examples.en_plain: Ancient Chinese inventions changed the world, like paper and printing.
examples.cn_plain: 古代中国的发明改变了世界，如造纸术和印刷术。

examples.sense: a. 古老的、年代久远的
examples.en: There is an [ancient] temple in our town that is over a thousand years old.
examples.cn: 我们镇上有一座[古老的]寺庙，已有一千多年历史。
examples.en_plain: There is an ancient temple in our town that is over a thousand years old.
examples.cn_plain: 我们镇上有一座古老的寺庙，已有一千多年历史。

examples.sense: a. 古老的（用于非正式语境，形容很旧）
examples.en: That [ancient] computer in the corner is too slow to use now.
examples.cn: 角落里那台[老旧的]电脑现在慢得没法用了。
examples.en_plain: That ancient computer in the corner is too slow to use now.
examples.cn_plain: 角落里那台老旧的电脑现在慢得没法用了。

examples.en: The [ancients] believed that the earth was the centre of the universe.
examples.cn: [古人]认为地球是宇宙的中心。
examples.en_plain: The ancients believed that the earth was the centre of the universe.
examples.cn_plain: 古人认为地球是宇宙的中心。

examples.en: I had bread [and] butter for breakfast this morning.
examples.cn: 今天早上我吃了面包[和]黄油。
examples.en_plain: I had bread and butter for breakfast this morning.
examples.cn_plain: 今天早上我吃了面包和黄油。

examples.en: My brother [and] I go to the same school.
examples.cn: 我兄弟[和]我上同一所学校。
examples.en_plain: My brother and I go to the same school.
examples.cn_plain: 我兄弟和我上同一所学校。

examples.sense: conj. 然后（连接动作的先后顺序）
examples.en: She opened the door [and] walked into the classroom.
examples.cn: 她推开门，[然后]走进了教室。
examples.en_plain: She opened the door and walked into the classroom.
examples.cn_plain: 她推开门，然后走进了教室。

examples.sense: conj. 以便（用在 go / come / try 之后）
examples.en: Come [and] see the new paintings in the school hall.
examples.cn: 来[看看]学校大厅里的新画作吧。
examples.en_plain: Come and see the new paintings in the school hall.
examples.cn_plain: 来看看学校大厅里的新画作吧。

examples.en: He studied hard [and] still failed the exam.
examples.cn: 他努力学习了，[但]还是考试不及格。
examples.en_plain: He studied hard and still failed the exam.
examples.cn_plain: 他努力学习了，但还是考试不及格。

examples.en: She was [angry] when she found out her brother had broken her phone.
examples.cn: 当她发现哥哥摔坏了她的手机时，她非常[生气]。
examples.en_plain: She was angry when she found out her brother had broken her phone.
examples.cn_plain: 当她发现哥哥摔坏了她的手机时，她非常生气。

examples.en: Don't say anything when you're [angry]; wait until you've calmed down.
examples.cn: [生气]的时候不要说话，等冷静下来再说。
examples.en_plain: Don't say anything when you're angry; wait until you've calmed down.
examples.cn_plain: 生气的时候不要说话，等冷静下来再说。

examples.en: The teacher was [angry] with the students who hadn't done their homework.
examples.cn: 老师对那些没完成作业的学生[生气]了。
examples.en_plain: The teacher was angry with the students who hadn't done their homework.
examples.cn_plain: 老师对那些没完成作业的学生生气了。

examples.en: He was [angry] about the unfair result of the competition.
examples.cn: 他对比赛不公平的结果感到[愤怒]。
examples.en_plain: He was angry about the unfair result of the competition.
examples.cn_plain: 他对比赛不公平的结果感到愤怒。

examples.sense: a. 狂怒的（形容天气/自然）
examples.en: The [angry] sea made it impossible for the boats to go out.
examples.cn: [汹涌]的大海使船只无法出行。
examples.en_plain: The angry sea made it impossible for the boats to go out.
examples.cn_plain: 汹涌的大海使船只无法出行。

examples.en: The zoo has a wide variety of [animals] from all over the world.
examples.cn: 这家动物园里有来自世界各地的各种各样的[动物]。
examples.en_plain: The zoo has a wide variety of animals from all over the world.
examples.cn_plain: 这家动物园里有来自世界各地的各种各样的动物。

examples.en: My favourite [animal] is the panda because it is so cute.
examples.cn: 我最喜欢的[动物]是熊猫，因为它太可爱了。
examples.en_plain: My favourite animal is the panda because it is so cute.
examples.cn_plain: 我最喜欢的动物是熊猫，因为它太可爱了。

examples.sense: n. 野兽（贬义，指行为粗野的人）
examples.en: Some people [animal]-like behaviour is hard to forgive.
examples.cn: 有些人的[兽性]行为让人难以原谅。
examples.en_plain: Some people's animal-like behaviour is hard to forgive.
examples.cn_plain: 有些人的兽性行为让人难以原谅。

examples.sense: a. 动物的、肉体的（animal instinct）
examples.en: It is [animal] instinct for a mother to protect her child.
examples.cn: 母亲保护孩子是一种[动物]本能。
examples.en_plain: It is animal instinct for a mother to protect her child.
examples.cn_plain: 母亲保护孩子是一种动物本能。

examples.sense: n. 动物（野生动物保护）
examples.en: We must protect wild [animals] and their natural habitats.
examples.cn: 我们必须保护野生[动物]及其自然栖息地。
examples.en_plain: We must protect wild animals and their natural habitats.
examples.cn_plain: 我们必须保护野生动物及其自然栖息地。

examples.sense: a. 另一个（同类中再取一个）
examples.en: Could I have [another] glass of water, please?
examples.cn: 请问我能再要[一杯]水吗？
examples.en_plain: Could I have another glass of water, please?
examples.cn_plain: 请问我能再要一杯水吗？

examples.sense: a. 另一个（同类中再取一个）
examples.en: I made a mistake; let me try [another] way to solve this problem.
examples.cn: 我犯了一个错误；让我试试[另一种]方法来解决这个问题。
examples.en_plain: I made a mistake; let me try another way to solve this problem.
examples.cn_plain: 我犯了一个错误；让我试试另一种方法来解决这个问题。

examples.en: This book is interesting, but I'd like to read [another].
examples.cn: 这本书很有趣，但我想再读[另一本]。
examples.en_plain: This book is interesting, but I'd like to read another.
examples.cn_plain: 这本书很有趣，但我想再读另一本。

examples.sense: a. 不同的（a completely different one）
examples.en: That is [another] matter altogether; let's deal with it separately.
examples.cn: 那完全是[另一回事]，我们单独处理吧。
examples.en_plain: That is another matter altogether; let's deal with it separately.
examples.cn_plain: 那完全是另一回事，我们单独处理吧。

examples.sense: prep. 又一（one another 互相）
examples.en: We should help one [another] and not be selfish.
examples.cn: 我们应该[互相]帮助，而不是自私自利。
examples.en_plain: We should help one another and not be selfish.
examples.cn_plain: 我们应该互相帮助，而不是自私自利。

examples.en: Can anyone give me the [answer] to question five?
examples.cn: 有人能告诉我第五题的[答案]吗？
examples.en_plain: Can anyone give me the answer to question five?
examples.cn_plain: 有人能告诉我第五题的答案吗？

examples.en: The [answer] to the maths problem is on the last page.
examples.cn: 这道数学题的[答案]在最后一页。
examples.en_plain: The answer to the maths problem is on the last page.
examples.cn_plain: 这道数学题的答案在最后一页。

examples.en: She [answered] all the questions correctly and got full marks.
examples.cn: 她[回答]了所有问题，全部正确，得了满分。
examples.en_plain: She answered all the questions correctly and got full marks.
examples.cn_plain: 她回答了所有问题，全部正确，得了满分。

examples.en: He didn't [answer] the phone because he was in the shower.
examples.cn: 他没有[接]电话，因为他正在洗澡。
examples.en_plain: He didn't answer the phone because he was in the shower.
examples.cn_plain: 他没有接电话，因为他正在洗澡。

examples.en: This plan [answers] all the requirements set by the school.
examples.cn: 这个计划[符合]学校设定的所有要求。
examples.en_plain: This plan answers all the requirements set by the school.
examples.cn_plain: 这个计划符合学校设定的所有要求。

examples.en: A line of [ants] was carrying food back to their nest.
examples.cn: 一排[蚂蚁]正把食物搬回巢穴。
examples.en_plain: A line of ants was carrying food back to their nest.
examples.cn_plain: 一排蚂蚁正把食物搬回巢穴。

examples.en: [Ants] can carry things many times heavier than themselves.
examples.cn: [蚂蚁]能搬运比自身重许多倍的东西。
examples.en_plain: Ants can carry things many times heavier than themselves.
examples.cn_plain: 蚂蚁能搬运比自身重许多倍的东西。

examples.en: [Ants] live and work together in large groups called colonies.
examples.cn: [蚂蚁]以大型群体（称为蚁群）共同生活和工作。
examples.en_plain: Ants live and work together in large groups called colonies.
examples.cn_plain: 蚂蚁以大型群体（称为蚁群）共同生活和工作。

examples.en: Be like an [ant] and work hard every day to reach your goal.
examples.cn: 要像[蚂蚁]一样，每天努力工作，朝目标前进。
examples.en_plain: Be like an ant and work hard every day to reach your goal.
examples.cn_plain: 要像蚂蚁一样，每天努力工作，朝目标前进。

examples.en: The children watched an [ant] crawl slowly across the leaf.
examples.cn: 孩子们看着一只[蚂蚁]慢慢地爬过树叶。
examples.en_plain: The children watched an ant crawl slowly across the leaf.
examples.cn_plain: 孩子们看着一只蚂蚁慢慢地爬过树叶。

examples.sense: a. 任何的（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: Do you have [any] questions before we start the test?
examples.cn: 在我们开始考试之前，你们有[任何]问题吗？
examples.en_plain: Do you have any questions before we start the test?
examples.cn_plain: 在我们开始考试之前，你们有任何问题吗？

examples.sense: a. 任何的（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: I don't have [any] money left after buying the books.
examples.cn: 买了书之后，我一点钱都没有了。
examples.en_plain: I don't have any money left after buying the books.
examples.cn_plain: 买了书之后，我一点钱都没有了。

examples.sense: a. 任何一个（肯定句，强调随便哪个）
examples.en: [Any] student who works hard can improve their grades.
examples.cn: [任何]努力学习的学生都能提高成绩。
examples.en_plain: Any student who works hard can improve their grades.
examples.cn_plain: 任何努力学习的学生都能提高成绩。

examples.en: I looked everywhere for my keys but couldn't find [any].
examples.cn: 我到处找钥匙，但一把也没找到。
examples.en_plain: I looked everywhere for my keys but couldn't find any.
examples.cn_plain: 我到处找钥匙，但一把也没找到。

examples.sense: adv. 一点、稍微（修饰比较级）
examples.en: Is your headache [any] better after taking the medicine?
examples.cn: 吃了药之后头痛有[好一点]吗？
examples.en_plain: Is your headache any better after taking the medicine?
examples.cn_plain: 吃了药之后头痛有好一点吗？

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: Is there [anybody] in the classroom right now?
examples.cn: 现在教室里有[任何人]吗？
examples.en_plain: Is there anybody in the classroom right now?
examples.cn_plain: 现在教室里有任何人吗？

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（疑问/否定句）
examples.en: I don't think [anybody] noticed that I was late.
examples.cn: 我觉得没有[任何人]注意到我迟到了。
examples.en_plain: I don't think anybody noticed that I was late.
examples.cn_plain: 我觉得没有任何人注意到我迟到了。

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（肯定句，泛指所有人）
examples.en: [Anybody] can learn to cook if they try hard enough.
examples.cn: 只要足够努力，[任何人]都能学会做饭。
examples.en_plain: Anybody can learn to cook if they try hard enough.
examples.cn_plain: 只要足够努力，任何人都能学会做饭。

examples.en: [Anybody] would feel nervous before speaking in front of a large crowd.
examples.cn: 在大众面前发言，[任何人]都会紧张。
examples.en_plain: Anybody would feel nervous before speaking in front of a large crowd.
examples.cn_plain: 在大众面前发言，任何人都会紧张。

examples.sense: n. 重要人物（somebody / nobody 对比）
examples.en: He is not just [anybody]; he is the school's best athlete.
examples.cn: 他不是[普通人]；他是学校最优秀的运动员。
examples.en_plain: He is not just anybody; he is the school's best athlete.
examples.cn_plain: 他不是普通人；他是学校最优秀的运动员。

examples.en: Has [anyone] seen my notebook? I can't find it.
examples.cn: 有[任何人]看到我的笔记本吗？我找不到了。
examples.en_plain: Has anyone seen my notebook? I can't find it.
examples.cn_plain: 有任何人看到我的笔记本吗？我找不到了。

examples.en: Can [anyone] explain why the answer is wrong?
examples.cn: 有[人]能解释一下为什么这个答案是错的吗？
examples.en_plain: Can anyone explain why the answer is wrong?
examples.cn_plain: 有人能解释一下为什么这个答案是错的吗？

examples.en: She didn't tell [anyone] about her plan to change schools.
examples.cn: 她没有告诉[任何人]她转学的计划。
examples.en_plain: She didn't tell anyone about her plan to change schools.
examples.cn_plain: 她没有告诉任何人她转学的计划。

examples.sense: pron. 任何人（肯定句，泛指）
examples.en: [Anyone] who wants to join the club should sign up by Friday.
examples.cn: [任何]想加入俱乐部的人应在周五前报名。
examples.en_plain: Anyone who wants to join the club should sign up by Friday.

examples.cn: 物以类聚——人们会选择[志同道合]的朋友。

examples.en: Draw a straight [line] under the title of your essay.
examples.cn: 在作文标题下画一条直[线]。

examples.en: There was a long [line] of students waiting for lunch.
examples.cn: 有一长排[队]学生在等候午饭。

examples.en: She memorised all her [lines] for the school play.
examples.cn: 她把学校话剧的所有[台词]都记住了。

examples.en: The metro [line] connects the school to the city centre.
examples.cn: 地铁[线路]连接学校和市中心。

examples.sense: v. 排成一排；整齐排列
examples.en: Trees [lined] both sides of the path to the school entrance.
examples.cn: 树木[排列]在通往学校入口的小路两旁。

examples.en: The [lion] is often called the king of the jungle.
examples.cn: [狮子]通常被称为丛林之王。

examples.en: The male [lion] has a magnificent mane around its neck.
examples.cn: 雄[狮]脖子周围有壮观的鬃毛。

examples.en: The team's captain fought like a [lion] to win the game.
examples.cn: 队长[像狮子]一样勇猛地战斗赢得比赛。

examples.en: He was treated like a [lion] after winning the national award.
examples.cn: 赢得全国奖项后，他被像[名人]一样对待。

examples.en: Stone [lions] guard the entrance to many traditional buildings.
examples.cn: 石[狮子]守护着许多传统建筑的入口。

examples.en: The teacher read out the [list] of students who had passed.
examples.cn: 老师念出了通过考试的学生[名单]。

examples.en: Please [list] three reasons why you want to join the club.
examples.cn: 请[列出]你想加入俱乐部的三个原因。

examples.en: She checked the shopping [list] before going to the supermarket.
examples.cn: 她去超市之前检查了购物[清单]。

examples.en: He made a [list] of everything he needed to do before the exam.
examples.cn: 他列了一份考试前需要做的所有事情的[清单]。

examples.en: The school [lists] all club activities on the notice board.
examples.cn: 学校在公告栏上[列出]所有俱乐部活动。

examples.en: Please [listen] carefully when the teacher explains the rules.
examples.cn: 老师解释规则时请仔细[听]。

examples.en: She [listened] to the music with her eyes closed.
examples.cn: 她闭着眼睛[聆听]音乐。

examples.en: He should [listen] to his parents' advice more often.
examples.cn: 他应该更多地[听从]父母的建议。

examples.en: They [listened] to the news on the radio every morning.
examples.cn: 他们每天早上[收听]收音机上的新闻。

examples.en: She [listened] carefully and understood the teacher's explanation.
examples.cn: 她仔细[聆听]并理解了老师的解释。

examples.en: Students must not drop [litter] in the school playground.
examples.cn: 学生不得在学校操场乱扔[垃圾]。

examples.en: Don't [litter] the street — use the rubbish bin.
examples.cn: 不要在街上乱[扔垃圾]——使用垃圾桶。

examples.en: The cat gave birth to a [litter] of five kittens.
examples.cn: 猫生了一[窝]五只小猫。

examples.en: Dead [litter] on the forest floor helps the soil stay healthy.
examples.cn: 森林地面的枯[叶层]有助于保持土壤健康。

examples.en: The injured player was carried off the field on a [litter].
examples.cn: 受伤的球员被抬上[担架]离开球场。

examples.en: A [little] bird sat on the branch outside the classroom window.
examples.cn: 一只[小]鸟坐在教室窗外的树枝上。

examples.en: There is very [little] time left, so we need to hurry.
examples.cn: 剩下的时间[很少]了，所以我们需要赶紧。

examples.en: She slept [little] the night before the big exam.
examples.cn: 重要考试前一晚她[几乎没]睡觉。

examples.en: Could I have a [little] more soup, please?
examples.cn: 请问我可以再来[一点]汤吗？

examples.en: The new student felt a [little] nervous on his first day.
examples.cn: 新同学第一天[有点]紧张。

examples.en: My grandparents [live] in a small village near the mountains.
examples.cn: 我的祖父母[居住]在山附近的一个小村庄。

examples.en: The old tree has [lived] for over five hundred years.
examples.cn: 这棵老树已经[存活]了五百多年。

examples.en: We watched a [live] concert on television last night.
examples.cn: 我们昨晚在电视上观看了[现场]音乐会。

examples.en: The science lesson used [live] insects to show how they move.
examples.cn: 科学课用[活]昆虫来展示它们的运动方式。

examples.en: He hopes to [live] a healthy life by eating well and exercising.
examples.cn: 他希望通过好好饮食和锻炼来[过]健康的生活。

examples.en: The [lively] puppy jumped around the yard all afternoon.
examples.cn: 那只[活泼的]小狗整个下午都在院子里跳来跳去。

examples.sense: adj. 热闹的；充满活力的
examples.en: The market was [lively] with music, laughter, and colourful stalls.
examples.cn: 市场上音乐、笑声和彩色摊位让气氛[热闹]非凡。

examples.en: The teacher used [lively] examples to make the lesson more interesting.
examples.cn: 老师用[生动]的例子使课程更有趣。

examples.en: She wore a [lively] red dress to the school party.
examples.cn: 她穿着一件[鲜艳]的红色连衣裙去参加学校派对。

examples.sense: adj. 积极的；富有朝气的
examples.en: The class had a [lively] debate about protecting the environment.
examples.cn: 班级就保护环境进行了[积极]的辩论。

examples.en: Remember to [lock] the door before you leave the house.
examples.cn: 离开房子前记得[锁]上门。

examples.en: The old [lock] on the gate was rusty and hard to open.
examples.cn: 大门上的旧[锁]生锈了，很难打开。

examples.en: He [locked] his bicycle to the fence outside the library.
examples.cn: 他把自行车[锁]在图书馆外的栅栏上。

examples.en: A [lock] of her hair fell across her face in the breeze.
examples.cn: 微风中，一[绺]头发飘落在她脸上。

examples.en: The two wrestlers [locked] arms and struggled for balance.
examples.cn: 两名摔跤手[紧握]双臂，努力保持平衡。

examples.en: [London] is famous for its red double-decker buses and Big Ben.
examples.cn: [伦敦]以红色双层巴士和大本钟而闻名。

examples.en: My family visited [London] last summer and toured the British Museum.
examples.cn: 我的家人去年夏天参观了[伦敦]，游览了大英博物馆。

examples.en: [London] has been a major city for over two thousand years.
examples.cn: [伦敦]作为主要城市已有两千多年历史。

examples.en: Many world-class theatres and galleries are found in [London].
examples.cn: 许多世界级的剧院和画廊都位于[伦敦]。

examples.en: [London] stands on the River Thames in southeast England.
examples.cn: [伦敦]位于英格兰东南部泰晤士河畔。

examples.en: She felt very [lonely] after moving to a new city without any friends.
examples.cn: 搬到一个没有朋友的新城市后，她感到非常[孤独]。

examples.en: The farmhouse stood on a [lonely] hill far from the nearest town.
examples.cn: 农舍孤零零地立在远离最近城镇的[偏僻]山丘上。

examples.en: The [lonely] old man sat on the park bench feeding the pigeons every day.
examples.cn: 那位[孤单]的老人每天坐在公园长椅上喂鸽子。

examples.en: Rainy Sunday afternoons can feel [lonely] when there is nothing to do.
examples.cn: 下雨的周日下午无事可做时会感到[孤寂]。

examples.en: The new student looked [lonely] until her classmates invited her to join them.
examples.cn: 新同学看起来[孤独]，直到同学们邀请她加入他们。

examples.en: It was a [long] journey, so we brought snacks for the road.
examples.cn: 这是一段[漫长]的旅程，所以我们带了路上吃的零食。

examples.en: We had a [long] discussion about how to improve the school canteen.
examples.cn: 我们就如何改善学校食堂进行了[长时间]的讨论。

examples.en: How [long] have you been studying English?
examples.cn: 你学英语多[久]了？

examples.en: She [longed] to see her best friend again after the summer break.
examples.cn: 暑假后她[渴望]再次见到她最好的朋友。

examples.en: The explorer had a [long] way to go before reaching the summit.
examples.cn: 探险家在到达山顶之前还有[很远]的路要走。

examples.en: [Look] at the blackboard and copy down the homework.
examples.cn: [看]黑板，把作业抄下来。

examples.en: You [look] tired today — did you sleep well last night?
examples.cn: 你今天[看起来]很疲倦——昨晚睡得好吗？

examples.en: I've been [looking] for my keys everywhere but can't find them.
examples.cn: 我到处[找]我的钥匙，但找不到。

examples.en: The new classroom has a fresh, modern [look] after the renovation.
examples.cn: 翻新后，新教室有了清新、现代的[外观]。

examples.en: The hotel room [looks] out onto a beautiful garden.
examples.cn: 酒店房间[朝向]一个美丽的花园。

examples.en: Be careful not to [lose] your student ID card at school.
examples.cn: 注意不要在学校[丢失]你的学生证。

examples.en: Our football team [lost] the match by two goals yesterday.
examples.cn: 我们的足球队昨天以两球之差[输掉]了比赛。

examples.en: She did not want to [lose] the trust of her classmates.
examples.cn: 她不想[失去]同学们的信任。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to [lose] some weight through exercise.
examples.cn: 医生建议他通过锻炼来[减轻]体重。

examples.en: We [lost] our way in the forest and had to use a map.
examples.cn: 我们在森林里[迷路]了，不得不使用地图。

examples.en: There is a [lot] of homework this week because of the upcoming exam.
examples.cn: 因为即将到来的考试，这周有[大量]作业。

examples.en: The teacher divided the books into three [lots] for different groups.
examples.cn: 老师把书分成三[批]分给不同的小组。

examples.en: He accepted his [lot] in life and worked hard to improve it.
examples.cn: 他接受了自己的[命运]，并努力改变它。

examples.en: There is a large parking [lot] behind the shopping centre.
examples.cn: 购物中心后面有一个大[停车场]。

examples.en: She likes reading a [lot] and spends most evenings with a book.
examples.cn: 她[非常]喜欢阅读，大多数晚上都捧着一本书。

examples.en: Please do not play [loud] music in the library — others are studying.
examples.cn: 请不要在图书馆播放[响亮]的音乐——其他人在学习。

examples.en: The playground was [loud] with the sound of children laughing.
examples.cn: 操场上充满了孩子们笑声，十分[喧闹]。

examples.en: She had to speak [loud] so everyone in the hall could hear her.
examples.cn: 她不得不[大声]说话，这样大厅里的每个人都能听到她。

examples.sense: adj. 鲜艳的；刺眼的（颜色）
examples.en: His [loud] yellow jacket made him easy to spot in the crowd.
examples.cn: 他那件[鲜艳]的黄色夹克让他在人群中很容易被发现。

examples.en: There was a [loud] cheer from the audience when the team scored.
examples.cn: 当球队得分时，观众发出了[热烈]的欢呼声。

examples.en: I [love] reading science fiction novels in my spare time.
examples.cn: 我[热爱]在业余时间阅读科幻小说。

examples.en: The story is about the [love] between a young prince and a village girl.
examples.cn: 这个故事讲述了一位年轻王子和一个村姑之间的[爱情]。

examples.en: She [loves] cooking new recipes on weekends with her mother.
examples.cn: 她[很喜欢]在周末和母亲一起烹饪新菜谱。

examples.en: His grandmother always called him [love] when she greeted him.
examples.cn: 他的祖母见到他时总称他为[亲爱的]。

examples.en: The score is forty-[love], meaning one player has zero points.
examples.cn: 比分是四十比[零]，意味着一方得了零分。

examples.en: The park looks [lovely] in spring when all the flowers bloom.
examples.cn: 春天所有花朵盛开时，公园看起来[美丽]极了。

examples.sense: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的
examples.en: We had a [lovely] picnic by the river on Sunday afternoon.
examples.cn: 周日下午我们在河边进行了一次[愉快]的野餐。

examples.en: She wore a [lovely] blue dress to the graduation ceremony.
examples.cn: 她穿着一件[迷人]的蓝色连衣裙参加毕业典礼。

examples.sense: adj. 友善的；讨人喜欢的
examples.en: The new neighbours are [lovely] people who always say hello.
examples.cn: 新邻居是[友善]的人，总是打招呼。

examples.en: What a [lovely] idea to plant a vegetable garden at school!
examples.cn: 在学校种菜园真是个[极好]的主意！

examples.en: The shelf was too [low] for the tall books to stand upright.
examples.cn: 书架太[低]了，高大的书无法直立放置。

examples.en: The fuel in the car was getting [low], so they stopped at a petrol station.
examples.cn: 车里的燃油[不足]了，所以他们在加油站停了下来。

examples.en: She spoke in a [low] voice so as not to wake the baby.
examples.cn: 她用[低沉]的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。

examples.en: The plane flew [low] over the fields as it prepared to land.
examples.cn: 飞机准备降落时在田野上[低低地]飞行。

examples.en: He felt [low] after failing the test but decided to study harder.
examples.cn: 他考试失败后感到[低落]，但决定更加努力学习。

examples.en: Good [luck] on your exam tomorrow — you have prepared well.
examples.cn: 祝你明天考试[好运]——你已经准备得很好了。

examples.en: It was bad [luck] that it rained on the day of the school trip.
examples.cn: 真倒[霉]，学校春游那天下雨了。

examples.en: Finding a taxi so quickly was a piece of [luck] on a rainy day.
examples.cn: 在雨天这么快找到出租车真是[幸运]。

examples.en: Success comes not just from [luck] but also from hard work.
examples.cn: 成功不仅来自[运气]，还来自努力工作。

examples.en: In China, the number eight is considered a symbol of [luck].
examples.cn: 在中国，数字八被认为是[好运]的象征。

examples.en: She felt [lucky] to win first prize in the drawing competition.
examples.cn: 她感到很[幸运]，在绘画比赛中赢得了一等奖。

examples.en: He always carries a [lucky] coin in his pocket before exams.
examples.cn: 他考试前总是在口袋里装一枚[幸运]硬币。

examples.en: It was [lucky] that I remembered to bring an umbrella today.
examples.cn: 真[碰巧]，我今天记得带了雨伞。

examples.en: Guessing the right answer was a [lucky] chance, not knowledge.
examples.cn: 猜对答案是[运气]，不是知识。

examples.en: We had a [lucky] escape when the storm missed our town.
examples.cn: 暴风雨没有袭击我们的城镇，我们真是[幸运]地逃过了。

examples.en: We have [lunch] in the school canteen at half past twelve.
examples.cn: 我们在十二点半在学校食堂吃[午餐]。

examples.en: During [lunch], students can read, play, or chat with friends.
examples.cn: 在[午餐时间]，学生可以阅读、玩耍或和朋友聊天。

examples.en: The teachers [lunch] together in the staff room every weekday.
examples.cn: 老师们每个工作日在教职员休息室一起[吃午饭]。

examples.en: She packed a healthy [lunch] with a sandwich, fruit, and juice.
examples.cn: 她打包了一份健康的[午饭]，包括三明治、水果和果汁。

examples.sense: n. 午间聚会；工作午餐
examples.en: The principal held a [lunch] meeting with the class representatives.
examples.cn: 校长与班级代表举行了一次[午餐]会议。

examples.en: The factory uses a [machine] to pack the products quickly.
examples.cn: 工厂使用[机器]快速包装产品。

examples.en: A washing [machine] saves a lot of time compared to washing by hand.
examples.cn: 洗衣[机]与手洗相比节省了大量时间。

examples.en: I bought a bottle of water from the vending [machine] in the corridor.
examples.cn: 我从走廊里的自动售卖[机]买了一瓶水。

examples.en: The government [machine] works to provide services to all citizens.
examples.cn: 政府[机构]致力于为所有公民提供服务。

examples.en: My [machine] crashed and I lost all my homework files.
examples.cn: 我的[电脑]崩溃了，我丢失了所有作业文件。

examples.en: She was [mad] at her brother for breaking her favourite mug.
examples.cn: 她对哥哥[生气]，因为他打碎了她最喜欢的杯子。

examples.en: It seems [mad] to go swimming in such cold weather.
examples.cn: 在这么冷的天气去游泳似乎很[疯狂]。

examples.en: He is [mad] about football and watches every match he can.
examples.cn: 他对足球[痴迷]，尽可能地观看每场比赛。

examples.en: It was [mad] to leave the house without a coat in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天不穿外套就出门是[鲁莽]的。

examples.en: The character in the story pretended to be [mad] to escape punishment.
examples.cn: 故事中的人物假装[疯狂]以逃避惩罚。

examples.en: Excuse me, [Madam], I think you dropped your scarf.
examples.cn: 打扰了，[女士]，我想您掉了围巾。

examples.sense: n. 对女性官员的称呼
examples.en: The students addressed the principal as [Madam] during the ceremony.
examples.cn: 学生们在典礼上称呼校长为[女士]。

examples.sense: n. 对陌生女性的礼貌称呼
examples.en: The shop assistant said, 'How may I help you, [Madam]?'
examples.cn: 售货员说：'[女士]，我可以为您效劳吗？'

examples.sense: n. 女主人；主事的女性
examples.en: She ran the household like a true [madam], organising everything.
examples.cn: 她像真正的[主妇]一样管理家务，安排一切。

examples.sense: n. 自以为是的女孩（口语）
examples.en: Don't be such a little [madam] — share the toys with your sister.
examples.cn: 别这么[自以为是]——把玩具分给妹妹。
